table.name: AREA_CODE_STATE
table.purpose: Lookup table mapping telephone area codes to US states/territories, likely used to derive a contestant's or voter's state from a phone number (e.g., in CONTESTANTS or VOTES).

area_code.name: area_code
area_code.description: North American Numbering Plan telephone area code (201–989), primary key; one row per area code.

state.name: state
state.description: US state (or territory) two-letter postal code that the area code is assigned to; 51 distinct values (50 states + DC, presumably).

table.name: CONTESTANTS
table.purpose: Roster of the 11 contestants in a contest, each with a unique contestant number that votes in the VOTES table refer to. Likely a phone-in voting contest (given the AREA_CODE_STATE table) where callers vote for contestants by number.

contestant_name.name: contestant_name
contestant_name.description: Full name of a contestant; each of the 11 rows is a distinct person.

contestant_number.name: contestant_number
contestant_number.description: Contestant's assigned number (1-11), the primary key of the table; referenced by VOTES.contestant_number, so votes are cast for a contestant via this number.

table.name: VOTES
table.purpose: One row per vote cast (likely by phone/SMS) for a contestant in a contest; records who voted (phone number and state) and when, and which contestant the vote went to. Links to CONTESTANTS via contestant_number; state is consistent with AREA_CODE_STATE lookup by area code.

contestant_number.name: contestant_number
contestant_number.description: Identifier of the contestant being voted for; foreign key to CONTESTANTS.contestant_number (e.g. 2 = Tabatha Gehling).

created.name: created
created.description: Timestamp when the vote was cast (stored as VARCHAR, format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'); all samples fall within seconds of each other on 2018-03-09.

phone_number.name: phone_number
phone_number.description: Phone number of the voter, stored as a 10-digit integer (US-style, no formatting). The leading digits match the state column (e.g. 718... = NY, 620... = CA), consistent with votes cast by SMS/phone.

state.name: state
state.description: US state (two-letter code) of the voter, derived from the phone number's area code (matches AREA_CODE_STATE). Note one value has a trailing newline ('NJ\n'), indicating dirty data.

vote_id.name: vote_id
vote_id.description: Primary key; unique identifier for each vote record.
